seoTitle: How to Reset Your TradingView Password Easily
metaDescription: Forgot your TradingView password? Follow this step-by-step guide to reset it safely and fix issues if the reset email never arrives.
intro: Getting locked out of TradingView because you forgot your password is a common but fixable problem. This guide walks through the correct password reset process, what to do about email verification, and how to secure your account once you're back in.

steps.heading: Start the password reset process
steps.body: From the TradingView login screen, choose the forgot password option and enter the email address linked to your account.

steps.heading: Check your email for the reset link
steps.body: TradingView sends a reset link to your registered email — open it promptly, as reset links typically expire after a period of time.

steps.heading: Fix a missing reset email
steps.body: If the email doesn't arrive, check your spam folder, confirm you used the correct registered email, and wait a few minutes before requesting another reset.

steps.heading: Set a new secure password
steps.body: Choose a strong, unique password when resetting, ideally one you don't reuse on other sites.

steps.heading: Secure your account after reset
steps.body: After logging back in, review your account's connected devices and consider enabling two-factor authentication to prevent future lockouts.

faq.question: What if I no longer have access to my registered email?
faq.answer: You'll need to contact TradingView support directly to verify your identity and regain access, since the reset link only goes to the registered email.

faq.question: Why isn't the password reset email arriving?
faq.answer: This is often due to the email landing in spam, a typo in the entered email address, or a temporary delay — check your spam folder before requesting another reset.

faq.question: How long is the reset link valid?
faq.answer: Reset links generally expire after a limited window, so it's best to use the link soon after receiving it rather than waiting.

faq.question: Can I reset my password from the mobile app?
faq.answer: Yes, the forgot password option is also available from the TradingView mobile app login screen.
